title: SEC7r4: HMAC ctx->data/dataSz uninitialized after XMALLOC
description: In crypto2dev_hmac_setkey_ctx(), the XMALLOC for Crypto2DevHmacCtx does not initialize ctx->data or ctx->dataSz. wolfSSL XMALLOC maps to malloc(), which does not zero-initialize. On the first wc_HmacUpdate() call, ctx->dataSz is uninitialized garbage, leading to XMALLOC(garbage + inSz) — a massive or wrapping allocation — and if ctx->data is non-NULL garbage, XMEMCPY reads from that garbage pointer. This is a P0 heap corruption / out-of-bounds read. Triggered on the very first HmacUpdate after HmacSetKey. Fix: after the XMALLOC, set ctx->data = NULL and ctx->dataSz = 0 before filling the other fields, or zero the struct with XMEMSET before populating it.
